# Response Rehearsal

Response Rehearsal is a static, browser-only incident response tabletop planning and facilitation tool. It has no login, upload, learner profile, or server-side exercise storage. Use fictional or sanitized exercise details and follow the organization's own policies and professional advice.

## Primary pages

- Home and tool: https://responserehearsal.com/
- Facilitator guides: https://responserehearsal.com/guides
- 15-minute incident response drill: https://responserehearsal.com/15-minute-incident-response-drill
- 30-minute incident response tabletop guide: https://responserehearsal.com/30-minute-incident-response-tabletop
- 60-minute incident response tabletop facilitator guide: https://responserehearsal.com/60-minute-incident-response-tabletop

## Tool entry points

- Interactive Rehearsal: https://responserehearsal.com/?path=interactive
- 60-minute BEC rehearsal: https://responserehearsal.com/?path=interactive&type=phishing&org=smallBusiness&audience=mixed&focus=balanced&duration=60&difficulty=standard&gm=whole&rehearsal=phishing-bec
- Source-control platform outage rehearsal: https://responserehearsal.com/?path=interactive&type=supplyChain&org=smallBusiness&audience=mixed&focus=balanced&duration=60&difficulty=standard&gm=whole&seed=824619&rehearsal=supplyChain-source-control-platform-outage

The generated packets, choices, observations, and AAR material are planning aids. They are not legal advice, compliance certification, forensic findings, or a substitute for organization-specific incident response plans and qualified professional review.
